== SB0260_X.pdf
- 2025
69th Legislature 2025
SB 260
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ALTERATION OF SERVICE DISTRICT BOUNDARIES FOR CERTAIN
PURPOSES; PROVIDING THAT THE PURPOSES INCLUDE AN INABILITY TO ACCESS PUBLIC SERVICES
OR IMPROVEMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY SERVICES; PROVIDING FOR PETITION, PUBLIC HEARING,
AND ELECTION PROCEDURES FOR ALTERING SERVICE HOSPITAL DISTRICT BOUNDARIES;
